profile.headline: Software Engineering Leader
profile.summary:
I love building software platforms that simplify the development and operation of large scale software systems. I find fulfillment in enabling engineering teams to confidently deliver innovative software to customers with speed and reliability, while managing infrastructure costs to drive successful business outcomes.

I've built cloud infrastructure that serves millions of requests per second, and platforms that support hundreds of deployments per day.

positions.title: Staff Engineering Manager
positions.description: Led develompent of cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes platforms, site reliability, and technical operations.
positions.insights: Skills: Python · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Databases · Terraform · Platform Architecture · Project Management · Shell · Kubernetes · Amazon EKS · Datadog · Amazon Relational Database Service (RDS) · Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD)
